description: This file defines the 'WithEntity' interface, which is part of the signals commands base package in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It specifies methods for working with entities represented as JSON, including default implementations for obtaining JSON as a string or object, and abstract methods for setting and getting entities with specified JSON schema versions.

classes.name: WithEntity
classes.description: An interface for entities associated with Eclipse Ditto signals, providing methods to access and modify the entity as JSON or plain string, with support for JSON schema versions.

methods.name: getEntityPlainString
methods.description: Returns an optional plain JSON string representation of the entity; defaults to empty.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity as JSON with the default or specified schema version.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity and returns a new instance with the entity set; may throw NullPointerException if input is null.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity as JSON according to the specified schema version.
